name: Omarchy10k

description: Control Center for the Omarchy10k shell experience. Configure prompt style, theme, segments, and shell integrations from the Quattro bar.

schema.label: Git activity dot
schema.description: A dot beside the glyph when the working tree is dirty or has staged changes.

schema.label: Coding-agent badge
schema.description: Shown when the last prompt render detected Claude Code or Codex.

schema.label: Long-command badge
